verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on 2 Chronicles 36

Jehoahaz deposed by Necho after three months, tribute 100 talents of silver and a talent of gold; 36:6 does not say Jehoiakim reached Babylon (Knapp: perhaps released); "eight" for Jehoiachin probably a copyist's error; the land owed seventy sabbaths after about 490 years of neglect; Cyrus's decree 538, Babylon fell 539; 605, 597 (16 March) and 586 (one passage says 587)
